import numpy as np

def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    npaths = perf.shape[0]
    ndates = perf.shape[1]
    cash = np.zeros((npaths, ndates), dtype=float)
    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    finalidx = int(terms["final_index"])
    downside = terms["downside"]
    level = float(downside["level"]) if downside is not None else 0.7
    gearing = float(downside["gearing"]) if downside is not None else 1.0
    digitalreturn = 0.0734
    worst = np.min(perf, axis=2)
    alive = np.ones(npaths, dtype=bool)
    autocall = terms["autocall"]
    coupon = terms["coupon"]
    missed = np.zeros(npaths, dtype=float)
    for k in range(ndates):
        isfinal = k == finalidx
        if coupon is not None and not isfinal:
            couponamount = coupon["amounts"][k]
            if couponamount is not None:
                couponamount = float(couponamount)
                eligible = alive & (worst[:, k] >= float(coupon["barrier"]))
                if bool(coupon["memory"]):
                    cash[eligible, k] += couponamount * (missed[eligible] + 1.0)
                    missed[eligible] = 0.0
                    missed[alive & ~eligible] += 1.0
                else:
                    cash[eligible, k] += couponamount
        if autocall is not None:
            callamount = autocall["call_amounts"][k]
            if callamount is not None:
                callnow = alive & (worst[:, k] >= float(autocall["trigger"]))
                if np.any(callnow):
                    cash[callnow, k] += float(callamount)
                    alive[callnow] = False
                    if isfinal:
                        return cash
                    continue
        if isfinal:
            finalworst = worst[:, k]
            maturity = np.where(finalworst >= level, notional * (1.0 + digitalreturn), notional * np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 + gearing * (finalworst - 1.0)))
            cash[alive, k] += maturity[alive]
            alive[:] = False
    return cash
